sm_top.sm: The United States evacuated B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom.
Missiles hit Aden airport as Iran rejects accusations.
The Houthis claimed an attack on Riyadh airport as fighting continues in Yemen.
A missile strike hit the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran, causing a limited fire.
An oil tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz following an incident.
A naval mine stopped a supertanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
An overnight drone attack hit St. Petersburg.
Intensifying clashes between Houthi and Yemeni government forces in Taiz have deepened the humanitarian crisis.
Russian strikes hit infrastructure in Kyiv, Ukraine.
Airstrikes at gold mines near the Sudan-Egypt border killed dozens of people.
Romanian fighter jets shot down two drones over the Black Sea.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted fresh drones and missiles over Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea.
An alleged terrorist plot directed by Iran was foiled at RAF Fairford in the UK.
UKMTO reported that a southbound tug was struck by two unknown projectiles off the UAE coast, causing damage and one minor injury.
Russia and Ukraine traded strikes on power infrastructure, leaving two dead and 17 injured overall.
Reports indicate the United States is weighing the potential use of the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast in strike plans against Iran.
Israeli strikes killed six Palestinians across Gaza over the course of a day.
Relief agencies and the ICRC report mounting pressure on Yemen's health system and widespread displacement as fighting intensifies.
Satellite images show Russia built a major new drone attack base in six weeks.
Ukrainian emergency services conducted search and recovery operations in Sloviansk following a Russian airstrike.
Poland scrambled aircraft as Russia launched strikes on Ukraine.
Restrictions were announced at Moscow airports as Ukrainian drone attacks closed the sky over Moscow.
Ukrainian forces struck a railway bridge and military depots in Bryansk Oblast.
Russian drone and missile attacks struck industrial and energy infrastructure in Kryvyi Rih and Zaporizhzhia, injuring several people.
The Saudi-led coalition carried out strikes targeting Houthi weapons-smuggling routes and missile launch platforms in Yemen.
A drone strike on a livestock market in Nyala killed 30 people.
A Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv resulted in one death and two injuries.
Saudi airstrikes caused civilian casualties in Yemen over a 24-hour period.
Air defenses intercepted incoming Houthi missile and drone attacks.
Houthis launched a deadly attack on Yemen's presidential palace, resulting in casualties.
Iran's IRGC Navy stated an oil tanker struck a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz, causing an explosion and engine room fire.
President Zelenskyy stated that Russia attacked Ukrainian energy infrastructure multiple times following a truce announcement.
Ukrainian forces struck the Roboavia drone manufacturing facility in Russia's Rostov Region.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claims Saudi warplanes conducted 110 airstrikes and missile attacks over 24 hours targeting civilian objects in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Taiz, Amran,
The Russian MoD claimed a drone strike hit a dry cargo ship carrying military and dual-use goods 50 km southwest of Odesa port.
Russian forces launched an attack on Rivne, causing fires to break out.
Russian aerial bombs struck Slovyansk, killing a 71-year-old woman and injuring 11.
Reported drone attacks on tankers in the Black Sea left crew members missing off Romania.
Russian forces seized control of 12 new settlements in Ukraine over the past week.
Russian airstrike hit a flea market in Kharkiv, killing 2 and injuring 19.
